annotations.title: Send feedback to the MSG91 team

description: Send feedback about MSG91 to the team that maintains it: a bug, something missing or wrong in the docs, a feature request, or praise. Use it when the user asks to report or suggest something, or when the docs or the API clearly didn't do what they say. Write the message so the team can act on it without the conversation: what was tried, what happened, what was expected. Never include tokens, passwords, API keys or the user's private data. Returns { ok, message }.

contact_email.description: The user's email, only if they asked to be contacted about it

message.description: The feedback itself, up to 5000 characters

page_or_endpoint.description: The docs page URL or the endpoint (e.g. POST /v1/messages) it is about, if any

type.description: What kind of feedback it is

name: send_feedback_to_msg91
